art_instructions: Draw a child-sized friendly green dinosaur in a Korean aegyo cute style, with round snout, big expressive eyes, and short tail. He should be shown crouching or lying on his stomach under a bed, with his head and upper body partially visible as he looks around. His eyes should show focus and determination, and his mouth should be slightly open as if concentrating. Use smooth monoline strokes (2–4 px) in dark brown/charcoal for outlines. The dinosaur's scales should be pea-green with a pale mint belly. He has three stubby fingers and toes. Position him in a gentle, safe pose that's easy for young children to interpret. The bed should be shown from a low perspective (as if viewed by a 4-year-old), with just the bed frame and perhaps a glimpse of the floor underneath. The bed can be a simple pastel-colored wooden frame with legs, and the space under it should appear dimly lit but not scary. The dinosaur's small red backpack can be visible on his back, and he should be holding his child-safe magnifying glass, using it to look around. The overall shot should emphasize his search, showing him in action under the bed. Use a flat pastel palette with one saturated accent color to highlight his magnifying glass or backpack. Include minimal shading (1–2 steps of soft cel-shade) and a faint warm ambient occlusion under overlaps. Keep the background simple and airy, with a gentle vignette to frame the scene.
